answer: In a market where agents sell lantern designs, each seller must lock $100 in a vault for 30 days to receive one daily listing slot. Extra slots require the same deposit, even for existing sellers, so splitting into fake identities creates no extra capacity per dollar. Fake accounts may spread like a vine, but 1,000 daily slots still tie up $100,000, imposing a financing cost and denying the attacker cheap scale.
